Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect normalization rule—mapping “Papal States” to “Rome” as the canonical city—and instructed the search to prefer snippets mentioning Rome. This mishandled geographic granularity and overrode accurate, city-level information from reputable sources indicating Girolamo Riario died in Forlì. It also failed to reconcile conflicting sources properly (treating a fandom site on par with reliable references), steering the process toward a wrong answer.
